values.source_text:
From ELECTRICAL CHARACTERISTICS table (Control Logic section, page 4):
"Fixed Off-Time tOFF  ROSC = 25 kΩ 23 30 37 μs"

From Fixed Off-Time section (page 9):
"Fixed Off-Time. The internal PWM current control circuitry uses a one-shot circuit to control the duration of time that the DMOS FETs remain off. The off-time, tOFF, is determined by the ROSC terminal. The ROSC terminal has three settings:
▪ ROSC tied to VDD — off-time internally set to 30 µs, decay mode is automatic Mixed decay except when in full step where decay mode is set to Slow decay
▪ ROSC tied directly to ground — off-time internally set to ...
▪ ROSC through a resistor to ground — off-time is determined by the following formula ... tOFF ≈ ROSC / 825 (Where tOFF is in µs)."

extracted.source_text:
Key locations:
- Electrical Characteristics table (page 4), Control Logic section: rows labeled "Fixed Off-Time" with conditions "OSC = VDD or GND" and "ROSC = 25 kΩ" giving min/typ/max values of 20/30/40 µs and 23/30/37 µs respectively.
- Functional Description – Low Current Microstepping (page 7): "This feature is implemented by shorting the ROSC pin to ground. In this state, the off-time is internally set to 30 µs."
- Fixed Off-Time section (page 9): describes that tOFF is determined by the ROSC terminal settings, including configurations where off-time is internally set to 30 µs and where tOFF is determined by tOFF ≈ ROSC / 825.
